text:
nina: Postmortem follow-up: two canary regressions last week. We need owners, thresholds, and a follow-through plan.

ryan: Agreed. Proposal: shrink initial blast radius, explicit auto-rollback, and a mandatory smoke test after each batch.

mira: Can we get concrete thresholds? Also add a pre-rollout model-version/tokenizer compatibility check.

sam: Thresholds proposal: initial 0.5%, then 3%, then 10%. Auto-rollback if error rate >= baseline +5pp for 3m OR p95 latency >= baseline +200ms for 2m. Block rollout if schema errors >0.2% in smoke tests. Max canary traffic 3%.

nina: Writing draft config snippet and will open INF-5230 tracking card. Owners suggested: sam (rollback impl + tests), ryan (rollout config + deploy), mira (metrics + runbook). Deadlines: tests Tue EOD, infra review Wed, staged rollout Thu.

sam: I'll add circuit-breaker tag routing so canary doesn't cascade. Also adding synthetic payloads for smoke harness. PR ETA Tue.

mira: I'll draft runbook snippet for on-call: how to read rollback signals, manual override steps, and escalation list. Pager for sev2+, slack for sev3.

ryan: Draft config (will commit to repo):
```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: small_batch
  batches: [0.5%, 3%, 10%]
  max_blast_radius: 3%
  auto_rollback: true
  rollback_rules:
    - metric: error_rate
      delta: 0.05
      window: 3m
    - metric: p95_latency
      delta_ms: 200
      window: 2m
  smoke_test:
    schema_error_threshold: 0.002
    run_after_each_batch: true
```

deploy-bot: Canary plan queued by @ryan: small-batch/v1 scheduled for 2026-06-01 02:00 UTC.

nina: Added recurring monthly "Rollout Safety Review" to revisit thresholds and incident trends. Once INF-5230 has PR links and runbook, we can tighten defaults. :thumbsup:
